findings.title: Fiscal chain integrity (CHAIN OK / TAMPERED) not surfaced in admin dashboard UI — auditor/owner-night UX gap
findings.where: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/ (no widget exists) + DashboardComponent.vue (admin dashboard root)
findings.evidence: Brief verification #2 expected `fiscal:verify-chain widget`. Empirical: grep of resources/ for verify-chain|chain_ok|chainOk|verifyChain|chainStatus = 0 hits. DOM scan of /admin/dashboard for /(CHAIN\s*OK|chaîne\s*intact|HMAC)/ = null. The CLI command exists (app/Console/Commands/FiscalVerifyChainCommand.php — NF525 Wave 3b heal 2026-05-18) but produces operator-CLI output only.
findings.impact: Auditeur-fiscal persona (NF525 control / owner-night safety check) cannot self-verify chain integrity from UI. They must SSH + artisan, which is not realistic during a service shift. Fiscal compliance posture relies on the chain — making its status invisible to operators is a transparency gap, NOT a NF525 violation per se (the chain itself is intact). CLAUDE.md §8 references fiscal:verify-chain as the on-demand check.
findings.remediation: Add a `FiscalChainStatusWidget.vue` next to LastZReportWidget. Wire it to a new GET /api/admin/fiscal/chain-status endpoint (thin controller calling AuditLogService::verifyChain + ZReportService::verifyChain). Cache 60s (chain verification is heavy). Surface 3 states: CHAIN OK (green badge), CHAIN TAMPERED (red banner + lock everything), VERIFY IN PROGRESS (spinner). Estimated LOC: ~80 (Vue 40 + controller 30 + route 10). FROZEN ZONE NOTE: AuditLogService.php + ZReportService.php are NF525-frozen per CLAUDE.md §7 but their PUBLIC verifyChain() methods are callable from any wrapper (already used by the artisan command). No frozen-zone diff needed — only NEW Vue widget + NEW controller + NEW route. **PROPOSAL ONLY per DM1 — do not implement in this audit run.**

findings.title: Sidebar count diff vs prior wave-final (-3 entries) — likely spec-selector mismatch, NOT a regression
findings.evidence: Prior wave-final-2026-05-23 round-1 reported 26 unique sidebar entries. This round observes 23 visible entries. Diff: -3 (/admin/pos-orders-tracker, /admin/cash-sessions-report, /home). **Empirical regression check**: `git log d601fdd34..HEAD -- resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/` = NO commits. Only commit touching admin/ between waves is e49ef36c5 (PosCounterCollectModal.vue) — UNRELATED to sidebar. Therefore the -3 delta is NOT a source-code regression; it is almost certainly a DOM-selector difference between the two specs (wave-final's S7-07 query likely included /home top-bar link + a couple of expanded sub-menus that my `aside a[href]` filter excluded).
findings.impact: None. All 3 "missing" routes still resolve (verified pos-orders-tracker = 200 GET). No production behaviour change.
findings.remediation: No action required. Next round: normalize the sidebar-link-extraction selector across S7 specs to remove false-positive drift. Estimated LOC: 1 line in spec.

findings.title: Audit Trail vs Fiscal Audit Logs naming overlap — UI label may confuse auditor
findings.evidence: Dashboard widget 'Audit Trail (Historique des Actions)' reads from ActionLog (admin user actions: kiosk health events, push notifications, etc.) — NOT from the NF525 audit_logs HMAC chain. An auditor seeing 'Audit Trail' in the dashboard might assume they're looking at the fiscal chain. Two completely different tables (ActionLog = ops trace, audit_logs = NF525 fiscal append-only). The current FR label 'Historique des Actions' partially disambiguates but the English 'Audit Trail' in the heading is misleading.
findings.impact: Cognitive overhead for compliance reviewers. Not a defect.
findings.remediation: Rename the EN/FR keys: 'Audit Trail' → 'Activity Log' / 'Historique des Actions' → 'Journal d'activité'. Reserve 'Audit Trail'/'Piste d'audit' for the NF525 fiscal chain widget (S7-MEGA-F1). Estimated LOC: 3 i18n keys + 1 component heading. **PROPOSAL ONLY per DM1.**
